text:
{"people":[{"name":"Sam","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Farah","role":"solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Lucy","role":"ecommerce director, champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"Martin","role":"CFO, final decision","side":"customer"},{"name":"","role":"controller (unnamed), built side-by-side rate one-pager for Martin","side":"customer"},{"name":"","role":"IT lead (unnamed), would move only if finance approved","side":"customer"},{"name":"","role":"bank contact (unnamed), repriced the Fiserv rate","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv, through their bank",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their ecommerce director, Lucy, came inbound.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Evaluation began with inbound contact from the champion."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"about one in twelve online orders was failing at the payment step","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Failure rate later confirmed as customer dashboard figure (E6)."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"it was worse on the big baskets","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Failures concentrated on large orders, per customer."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"she couldn't get a straight answer from the processor on why","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Processor gave the customer no explanation for declines."},
{"id":"E5","turn":2,"excerpt":"Customers would call in annoyed, or just not come back.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's guess about customer impact; not reported by customer."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"Off their own dashboard.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep), on Lucy's figure","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The one-in-twelve failure rate comes from the customer's dashboard."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Lucy was the champion, she wanted it, IT was fine with it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Champion and IT aligned; CFO was the blocker."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"Martin said no.","label":"fact","speaker":"Martin, CFO (relayed by Lucy)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Final call reported secondhand; rep never met Martin."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"he doesn't take vendor meetings and she'd carry it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep never reached the decider; Lucy carried the pitch to him."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"They were on Fiserv through their bank, had been forever.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent was a long-running Fiserv relationship via their bank."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"when the bank heard, they came back and sharpened the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent bank repriced in response; the counter was rate-only."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"No new product, nothing. Just a better rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer reported the competitor's move was price only."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"Up to then Lucy was asking about declines.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Questions shifted from decline causes to rate after bank call."},
{"id":"E14","turn":12,"excerpt":"every email was the rate. Can you do better on the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Email questions narrowed to rate after the bank counteroffer."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy was nodding the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Decline explanation drew visible engagement from Lucy."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence, honestly, nothing bombed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read on pitch reaction; no clear negatives reported."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"We lost on price.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep's loss diagnosis; later hedged in T34 and T42."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"When Lucy came out of her meeting with Martin.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Timing of the loss signal: Lucy's post-CFO meeting call."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"he's not going to pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relaying Martin)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Core objection: rate framed as the same thing. Compare E27 wording."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before that she'd been telling me it was a formality.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Lucy's pre-meeting forecast was wrong; loss arrived late."},
{"id":"E21","turn":18,"excerpt":"The controller did a one-pager for Martin.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Internal side-by-side rate comparison went to the CFO."},
{"id":"E22","turn":20,"excerpt":"they pay a gateway fee on top","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer's true cost includes a gateway fee absent from the page."},
{"id":"E23","turn":20,"excerpt":"Which isn't fair","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's view that the rate-only comparison was unfair to us."},
{"id":"E24","turn":20,"excerpt":"But that's not on the statement line, so it wasn't on the page.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Rep assumes gateway fees were missing; rep was not in the room."},
{"id":"E25","turn":22,"excerpt":"Our quote.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Our quote was the only item from us on the comparison page."},
{"id":"E26","turn":24,"excerpt":"Lucy presented it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep absent; Lucy presented the comparison to CFO and controller."},
{"id":"E27","turn":24,"excerpt":"Why would I pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Martin, CFO (relayed by Lucy)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Same objection as E19, different wording."},
{"id":"E28","turn":28,"excerpt":"We showed the uplift slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Value pitched as a generic average, not a Fernbrook figure."},
{"id":"E29","turn":28,"excerpt":"Lucy got it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read; no customer statement of understanding reported."},
{"id":"E30","turn":30,"excerpt":"Farah offered to run their declines.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer-specific loss analysis was offered but never run."},
{"id":"E31","turn":30,"excerpt":"Lucy was sold.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's read; conflicts with Lucy's request for a CFO leave-behind."},
{"id":"E32","turn":30,"excerpt":"I didn't think we needed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep declined the value analysis; no customer-side reason given."},
{"id":"E33","turn":32,"excerpt":"Nothing from us.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Says nothing from us on failure cost reached Martin; conflicts with E25."},
{"id":"E34","turn":32,"excerpt":"I assume Lucy told him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Unverified assumption that Lucy briefed Martin on failure cost."},
{"id":"E35","turn":34,"excerpt":"Yes. Probably.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Hedged answer on whether matching price would have won."},
{"id":"E36","turn":34,"excerpt":"He'd said he'd do it if finance approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"IT lead (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"IT move conditional on finance; spring timing; finance is another gate."},
{"id":"E37","turn":34,"excerpt":"But the rate is what killed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's causal claim; same turn says 'maybe not only the rate'."},
{"id":"E38","turn":36,"excerpt":"Lucy asked once if we had something she could hand Martin.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer requested a CFO-ready leave-behind; we sent generic materials."},
{"id":"E39","turn":36,"excerpt":"I sent her the deck and the pricing proposal.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No Fernbrook-specific business case was sent."},
{"id":"E40","turn":38,"excerpt":"The customer stories. The average uplift.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Offered as the business case: generic stories and uplift averages."},
{"id":"E41","turn":40,"excerpt":"orders dying at the last step.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's failure language; our pitch said big-ticket orders get knocked back."},
{"id":"E42","turn":40,"excerpt":"the big baskets.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's segment label for large orders."},
{"id":"E43","turn":40,"excerpt":"we do all the work to get someone to buy a four-thousand-dollar greenhouse and then the card says no.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy, ecommerce director","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer frames the lost sale as a payment-step failure, not price."},
{"id":"E44","turn":42,"excerpt":"Get more room on the rate, earlier.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's rate-only recommendation for next time."},
{"id":"E45","turn":42,"excerpt":"If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rate-only counterfactual; does not address Martin's value objection."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E25","E33"],"what":"Rep says 'Our quote.' was on the comparison page, then says 'Nothing from us.' about what Martin had on failure cost."},
{"evidence":["E19","E27"],"what":"Same Martin objection is quoted in two wordings: 'he's not going to pay more for the same thing' and 'Why would I pay more for the same thing.'"},
{"evidence":["E31","E38"],"what":"Rep says 'Lucy was sold', yet Lucy asked for a CFO-ready leave-behind that was never built."},
{"evidence":["E17","E35","E37","E45"],"what":"Rep says 'We lost on price' and 'the rate is what killed it', then says 'maybe not only the rate' in T34."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Did we put a figure on the value they'd get?","turn":27,"what":"Answered with the generic uplift slide, not a Fernbrook figure (E28)."},
{"question":"So what did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?","turn":31,"what":"Answered 'Nothing from us' then 'I assume Lucy told him' (E33, E34)."},
{"question":"If we had matched the price, would we have won? What else would have needed to be true?","turn":33,"what":"Answered 'Yes. Probably.' then conceded 'maybe not only the rate' (E35)."},
{"question":"If you ran it again?","turn":41,"what":"Answered with a rate-only fix (E44, E45), despite earlier hedges about other factors."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"orders dying at the last step","ours":"big-ticket orders get knocked back","evidence":["E41"]},
{"theirs":"the card says no","ours":"knocked back","evidence":["E43"]},
{"theirs":"the same thing","ours":"the average improvement in acceptance","evidence":["E27","E28"]},
{"theirs":"a four-thousand-dollar greenhouse","ours":"the average uplift","evidence":["E43","E40"]},
{"theirs":"the big baskets","ours":"big-ticket orders","evidence":["E42"]},
{"theirs":"a better rate","ours":"our quote / the pricing proposal","evidence":["E12","E39"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E17"],"what":"Rep reports the deal was lost, diagnosed as price. Loss, not no-decision."},
{"evidence":["E8","E18","E20"],"what":"Martin's no came after Lucy's CFO meeting, per secondhand report. Transcript describes a full loss, not partial movement."},
{"evidence":["E36"],"what":"IT would move only if finance approved, with spring timing. No partial move is reported."}
]}
